objects.description: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has used process hollowing in iexplore.exe to load the [RedLeaves](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0153) implant.(Citation: Accenture Hogfish April 2018)
objects.description_fa: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) از حفره فرآیند در iexplore.exe برای بارگذاری ایمپلنت [RedLeaves](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0153) استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Accenture Hogfish April 2018)
